description: JSONL record types for the logging-only Pipelines filter. Every record carries schema_version and ts. events.jsonl carries hashes/metadata only — raw user/model content NEVER appears here (see samples.jsonl).

analysis.description: Written by the background worker, one per direction. decision is ALWAYS 'log' in Phase 1.

score_raw.description: verbatim classifier output (may be null on failure)

scores.description: 0.0-1.0 per class: prompt_injection, indirect_injection, secrets_exposure, pii_disclosure, poisoned_content

would_block.description: provisional >= 0.9; calibration label only, never acted on

would_redact.description: provisional >= 0.7; calibration label only, never acted on

drop.description: Explicit record for every queue-full drop (drop-newest policy).

filter_error.description: Hook-level failure that was contained (body still returned unmodified).

error.description: exception class name only, no message content

degraded.description: true while the circuit breaker is cooling down

label.description: Ground-truth labels: red-team probes (source=redteam) and human review (source=human, see labels.jsonl). Joined to analysis records by event_id in calibrate.py.

event_id.description: uuid4 hex, generated in inlet only

malformed.description: true when the body was not a usable OpenAI-style dict; excluded from calibration eligibility

messages.description: per-message metadata; content hashed, never stored

user_hash.description: sha256 of user id; never raw

event_id.description: inherited from inlet via correlation map, or fresh on miss

sha256.description: hash of response text; text never stored

response_leak.description: SSRF Addendum B (approved 2026-10-07). Written synchronously in outlet(). Counts only; raw matches never leave memory.

ssrf_probe.description: SSRF Addendum A (approved 2026-10-07). One per candidate URL, written by the worker. Hostnames only; query strings stripped before hashing.

any_flag.description: true if any resolved IP is non-public

host.description: parsed hostname only; never the full URL

url_hash.description: sha256 of URL with query/fragment stripped

samples_jsonl.description: samples.jsonl (mode 0600) is the ONLY place raw content may exist: the 1% random sample plus red-team probes store {event_id, ts, raw_text}. It is NOT validated by validate_logs.py's no-raw-content rule — it is exempt by design, with short retention.

title: Agent-Shield Phase 1 log schema
